name: 02-lifecycle
title: Close, archive and delete on the real stack (head 90bd1190)
subtitle: MySQL 8.4.7 + PR Spring jar + packaged Hosted Harness + Broker worker + real Shell; OSS double. 5 MiB stdout + 200 KiB stderr per Session
lines: ## Public API on a Workspace Session
!! POST /close -> 409 workspace_unavailable     DELETE -> 409 workspace_unavailable   (also on main)
== so close/delete are driven by a seam: the operation row + pending status beginOperation writes;
== the production SessionLifecycleCoordinator then runs settle() -> completeOperation() [-> retire()]
## CLOSE, then ARCHIVE
++ journal head SEALED, publication PINNED, no retirement row
++ artifacts list 200 (available, available); full download sha256 ok; Range 4096-8191 -> 206   (closed and archived)
## DELETE (seam -> production completeOperation, 0.96 s)
++ retirement row: op = the DELETE op, generation 1, recovery_protected 0; journal head DELETED, writer cleared
++ publication RETIRING, held bytes unchanged (5,453,392)
++ GET session 404, GET artifacts 404, GET content (full and Range) 404 session_not_found
++ writers:acquire with a new token -> 409 tool_output_session_retired
++ GET /restore and GET /resources/{id} -> 409 tool_output_session_retired
++ OSS: 7/7 objects still present, 0 DELETE requests
## Legacy Session (no Workspace, never had a private head) through the real public DELETE
++ 202 -> operation completed; retirement row written (generation 1); writers:acquire -> 409 retired
note: Every retention claim holds. The Workspace close/delete path itself is not reachable from the public API yet (same as found for #13087).

name: 03-writer-race
title: A writer that acquires between settle() and the delete commit
subtitle: SQL relay holds one completeOperation statement for 10 s; nothing in the jars is changed. The Harness has already SEALED the journal; acquire re-activates SEALED.
lines: ## head 90bd1190 — writer first (hold completeOperation's first statement, before any lock)
writers:acquire -> 200 in 17 ms (journal SEALED -> ACTIVE, generation 2, lease 15 s)
++ retry 1: ApiException "Session deletion is waiting for its writer to stop."   (the new in-transaction recheck)
++ retry 2, 3: settle() sees the live writer
++ deletion completes at +17.96 s, after the writer lease ended at +15.94 s
++ the old writer afterwards: restore 409 tool_output_session_retired, renew 409 tool_output_session_retired
## head 90bd1190 — deletion first (hold the operation row FOR UPDATE, after lockDeletion)
++ writers:acquire waits 9.9 s on the tenant row, then 409 tool_output_session_retired; delete done in 1 attempt
## base a7deb01b — same hold as "deletion first"
writers:acquire -> 200 in 14 ms
-- delete completes in 1 attempt: managed_agent_session DELETED, journal head still ACTIVE with the new writer
-- that writer keeps going: GET /restore -> 200 ACTIVE, writers:renew -> 200
note: The PR closes a real window: on main a writer can survive a completed public deletion and keep restoring/renewing.

name: 04-read-lease
title: In-flight public downloads: lease expiry, a paused JVM, deletion
subtitle: 64 MiB artifact, OSS GET throttled to 256 KiB/s so one download outlives 2 minutes; client = node:http; OSS GETs counted at the OSS double
lines: ## Expiry                                head 90bd1190                       base a7deb01b
read-timeout default (2m)            cut at 120.03 s, 30.6 MB            cut at 123.91 s, 31.5 MB
read-timeout=10m                     cut at 120.02 s, 31.2 MB            complete 64 MiB at 256.1 s, sha ok
++ head: last OSS GET started at 116.2 s; no GET after expiry; lease rows after the read: 0
!! head: the fixed 120 s lease caps every download regardless of read-timeout (documented in the README)
## SIGSTOP the Spring JVM at +5 s for 125 s, then SIGCONT
++ head: 16 KiB already in the socket after SIGCONT, 0 new OSS GETs, stream cut at 130.03 s
base: same (16 KiB, 0 GETs) — base's read-timeout guard also fires
## Session deleted at +10 s (seam -> production completeOperation)
++ head: retired at +10.84 s, stream ends at +12.07 s, 16 KiB after retirement, 0 new GETs, then 404
base: deleted at +10.76 s, ends at +11.79 s, 16 KiB after, 0 GETs, then 404 (base access guard)
## Statement cost of the lease (direct DB, 99 MiB full download, net of idle)
see 07-cost
note: Expired and retired readers stop before reopening storage. Stopping an in-flight download on delete is not new (main already does it); the new parts are the fixed budget and the retirement generation check.

name: 05-evidence-observer
title: PUT evidence and candidate observation on one database (o41obs)
subtitle: L written by the base jar and upgraded; E/P/T/Q/K/D/R written by head. All retired through the production coordinator. OSS DELETE requests during the whole run: 0
lines: ## Upgrade: base jar data -> head jar: V27 applied in 0.115 s; L = PINNED, write_evidence 0, accepted 0; still downloads
## P: reply of the first object PUT lost after OSS stored it (drop-reply), Worker retry
OSS: 200-reply-dropped, then 409 FileAlreadyExists for the same key
++ put attempts: RETURNED=4 UNKNOWN=1 (the UNKNOWN is the lost one); the retry did not close it
## (separate run) Admission object > 64 KiB lives in OSS; its PUT reply lost: RETURNED + UNKNOWN on that key
## T: capture budget 1 MiB, 3 MiB output -> accepted_complete 0     Q: one stored object bit-flipped -> read 503, quarantined
## K: recovery:block before delete -> retirement recovery_protected 1
## held bytes before/after retirement: identical for all 6 (no release without collection)
## Observer ticks
grace 24h : sample=6  {recovery_protected=1, grace_period=5}
grace 0   : sample=6  {eligible=1, put_unresolved=1, not_accepted_complete=1, quarantined=1,
recovery_protected=1, legacy_write_evidence_missing=1}   eligible_bytes = E's 2,388,859
reader R blocked inside an OSS GET while R is retired:
++              sample=8  {..., reader_active=1}
R's reader ends (SDK socket timeout 50.2 s) -> next tick: eligible=3
note: Each blocker shows up exactly once for the Session built to trigger it. Lease rows left by a SIGKILLed JVM are never deleted (harmless: candidates filter expires_at).

name: 06-oss-retry
title: F1 — setMaxErrorRetry(0) is client-wide: reads lose the SDK retry too
subtitle: Same jar pair, same inputs. The PUT ledger needs PutObject unretried; GetObject has no such constraint.
lines: ## OSS double: one GET 500 on segment 2 during an 8 MiB download
base a7deb01b   OSS saw 500 then 200 (SDK retry) -> 200, 8,388,608 bytes, sha ok
--    head 90bd1190   OSS saw 500 only                 -> 200 headers sent, body aborted after 2,097,152 bytes
## OSS double: stale pooled connection after the JVM was paused 125 s mid-download
both arms log  com.aliyun.oss [Client]Unable to execute HTTP request: Broken pipe
base: next Range -> 206          head: next Range -> 503 artifact_unavailable
## Real Aliyun OSS (temporary private bucket, cn-hangzhou, deleted afterwards)
++ head: 16 MiB publication = 17 objects, put attempts RETURNED=17, sha ok; full download and Range ok
pause the JVM 125 s mid-download, then three Range reads:
--    head 90bd1190   503 artifact_unavailable, 206, 206
== the delete issued after the pause stays DELETING on both arms (the Harness answers 503 to DELETE /session
== after the pause; pre-existing, base identical); content 404 while DELETING; 17/17 objects untouched
## Write side: one PUT 500 (the object was NOT stored)
output still completes through the Worker retry; ledger RETURNED=2 UNKNOWN=1
!! that publication can never become eligible: this slice has no path that resolves an UNKNOWN attempt
note: Suggestion: keep retries off only for PutObject (e.g. a second OSSClient with maxErrorRetry 0 used by putIfAbsent) and leave GetObject on the default client.

name: 07-cost
title: F2 — Database cost of the lease guards: reads x2, writes x6 under 1 ms
subtitle: Dedicated MySQL 8.4.7 (only this Spring), net SHOW GLOBAL STATUS deltas (idle subtracted). Relay = TCP relay adding 1 ms / 5 ms per client packet. read-timeout=10m on both arms.
lines: ## Read: 99 MiB full download                  base a7deb01b              head 90bd1190
statements (net)                            32,405  (327 / MiB)        67,352  (680 / MiB)
DB direct                                   4.06 s                     7.87 s
--    DB +5 ms                                   194.75 s, complete         cut at 120.37 s after 27.7 MiB
1 MiB Range: statements / time at +5 ms     322 / 1.96 s               1,167 / 7.14 s
## Write: one real 256 MiB Shell publication (Turn start -> Turn completed)
statements                                  17,890  (70 / MiB)         136,324  (533 / MiB)
DB direct                                   16.4 s                     26.9 s
## Where the extra statements come from (general_log, 16 MiB)
download  base 5,282   head 11,003 = +4,022 ReadLease.check  +1,601 retirement lookup in requireReferenced
write     base 2,432   head 10,581 = +6,822 ReadLease.check  + per-object lease/attempt txns (tenant row FOR UPDATE)
!! check() runs before AND after every socket read (OSS streams return a few KiB per read), plus once more in the
!! heartbeat: ~15.7 lease checks per 64 KiB on a download
## Largest download inside the fixed 120 s lease (head)    direct ~1.5 GiB   +1 ms ~126 MiB   +5 ms ~28 MiB
note: The checks run per socket read, so the cost depends on the object-store transport: through the OSS SDK over HTTPS a read returns a few KiB, and the 335.5 statements/MiB quoted in the PR thread does not reproduce (680/MiB; base 327). Checking once per filled 64 KiB buffer and dropping the duplicate requireLive would bring reads back near base.

name: 08-mutation
title: Mutation matrix: 26 single mutants of the O4-1 guards
subtitle: Each mutant: exact-once text replacement, then mvn -Pmysql-integration verify (unit + 26 MySQL IT, TZ=UTC). Control run green.
lines: ## Killed by the PR's own tests (20)
++ retire(): live-writer recheck off | DELETE completes without retire() | publications stay PINNED
++ recovery_protected never set | journal head not set DELETED | acquireWriter() without requireLive
++ lease granted on a retired Session | lease expiry ignored | retirement ignored by check() | budget 120 s -> 1 h
++ failed PUT recorded as RETURNED | candidate ignores put_unresolved / reader_active / recovery / grace /
++   legacy evidence / quarantine / accepted_complete | projection completes on a retired Session
++ content(): retired/expired not mapped to 404
## Survived (6)
== M03 lockDeletion() removed       retire() still locks the journal head FOR UPDATE; lock order only
== M07 requireReadGrant() requireLive removed     head is DELETED, the grant check already fails
== M08 publication authorize() requireLive removed  (only the known flaky test failed) writer token already dead
!! M21 admission writes accepted_complete = TRUE always   -> truncated/blocked captures become eligible
!! M25 admission object PUT (> 64 KiB, in OSS) bypasses the attempt ledger
!! M24 OSS SDK retries re-enabled (no test pins setMaxErrorRetry(0))
## Candidate test (+2 lines in publishesImmutableSegmentAndResourceUnderOriginalAuthorization)
assertThat(accepted_complete of pub-1).isEqualTo(!partial)
++ head: ToolPublicationStoreTest 62/62     with M21: 1 failure (killed)
note: Coverage is strong. M21 and M25 are behaviour that is correct on the real stack today (T and the admission-PUT run) but unpinned by tests.
